Please raise this enhancement in Rich Discussions first; new features need approval there before an issue is opened. For this layout, the Tables docs show using `Table.grid` as a layout tool, which can hold the `Rule` and table together: https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst#grids

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
